schedule: Two things dominate today. First, GoHighLevel emailed that your trial ends July 10 — six days out. Everything runs through GHL: the pipeline, the 27+ imported leads, the A2P registration, and all three workflows. Add billing today so a lapse can't torch two months of setup. Second, the local ads cache still shows the Lead-Gen campaign PAUSED as of Jul 3 — if that's real, no new leads are flowing and the $17 CPL machine is off. Confirm in Ads Manager whether the pause is intentional. Inbox has zero prospect replies for the second straight day, so follow-up on existing leads is the only revenue motion available. It's July 4 — home-service owners are off, so text beats calls and the 9 AM FB group auto-post should still fire.
